{"CommandLine":"& "D:\CareBridge AI\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "
from app import create_app
from app.core.database import connect_to_mongodb, get_database
from app.utils.security import create_access_token

app = create_app()
client = app.test_client()

connect_to_mongodb()
db = get_database()

user = db.users.find_one({'role': 'PATIENT'})
if not user:
    u_id = db.users.insert_one({'email': 'patient_test@carebridge.ai', 'role': 'PATIENT', 'name': 'Test Patient'}).inserted_id
else:
    u_id = user['_id']

token = create_access_token({'sub': str(u_id), 'role': 'PATIENT', 'email': 'patient_test@carebridge.ai'})
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'}

test_pass = db.opd_passes.find_one({})
pass_number = test_pass['pass_number'] if test_pass else 'OPD-20261009-TEST01'

val_res = client.post('/api/opd-pass/validate', json={'pass_number': pass_number}, headers=headers)
print('Validate pass status:', val_res.status_code, 'Valid:', val_res.json.get('valid'))

req_otp_res = client.post('/api/opd-pass/request-otp', json={'pass_number': pass_number}, headers=headers)
print('Request OTP status:', req_otp_res.status_code, 'Message:', req_otp_res.json.get('message'))
otp_code = req_otp_res.json.get('demo_otp')

if otp_code:
    ver_otp_res = client.post('/api/opd-pass/verify-otp', json={'pass_number': pass_number, 'otp': otp_code}, headers=headers)
    print('Verify OTP status:', ver_otp_res.status_code, 'Verified:', ver_otp_res.json.get('verified'), 'Msg:', ver_otp_res.json.get('message'))

hosp_res_in = client.get('/api/hospitals/?country=India')
print('Hospitals India status:', hosp_res_in.status_code, 'Total:', hosp_res_in.json.get('total'))

hosp_res_us = client.get('/api/hospitals/?country=USA')
print('Hospitals USA status:', hosp_res_us.status_code, 'Total:', hosp_res_us.json.get('total'))

hosp_res_em = client.get('/api/hospitals/?emergency=true')
print('Hospitals Emergency status:', hosp_res_em.status_code, 'Total:', hosp_res_em.json.get('total'))
